conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones, mixamorig: names), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.batters: rhb_/lhb_ clips use the batting frame (origin between the feet, +X toward the bowler's end, RHB chest faces -Y in the stance); bat on RightHand (rhb) / LeftHand (lhb); lhb_ = exact mirror across the pitch line (running_bat.mirror_y)
conventions.others: fielder_/captain_/presenter_ clips start at the origin facing the rig's forward direction (-Y); x = his left; ra_/la_ bowler clips use the bowling world (his popping crease at the origin, batter at -Y), la_ = mirror
conventions.loops: *_loop clips start and end in the same pose; walk-out loops are in place (speed_m_s given)
conventions.props: helmet / coin / microphone / ball: attach to the hand named in each clip's 'prop' note between the frames given
conventions.chaining: settle_after_* start from the last frame of the matching running clip and end in frame 1 of 75_non_striker_idle_loop turned 180 deg; take_guard ends in the batting stance; fielder_walk_back_to_position ends in run_00_ready_stance_idle_loop's first pose; mark_run_up ends standing at the mark facing the batter
conventions.toss_layout: flipper at the origin facing -Y; the other captain at x=+1.0 facing -Y; presenter at (0.5, -1.6) facing +Y (see captain_toss_flip's coin_* fields)
conventions.bat: bat-holding clips (rhb_/lhb_) have a bat track under their full clip name in bat_tracks.json: place the bat from it and IK the hands onto the handle (topgrip 0 = top hand free). Bottom hand: RightHand for rhb_, LeftHand for lhb_.
conventions.stance: take_guard, settle_after_*, warmup_* end exactly in the round-3 ready stance (batting_v2.READY = frame 1 of 00_stance_idle_loop / lhb_00_stance_idle_loop)
conventions.looks: round 7: toss-party clips look at eye height (1.68 m) on the person they face; PreMatchLook's IK can steer them from there. New idles: captain_idle_relaxed_loop, captain_listen_nod_loop, presenter_listen_loop

clips.layout: the other captain plays the same clip at (0, -1.0) facing +Y: both right hands meet at the midpoint
clips.note: steps in, shakes hands with three pumps, steps back

clips.layout: presenter_hold_mic_out_loop at (-0.30, -1.30) facing +Y puts the microphone where this clip leans to it
clips.note: the toss winner steps 0.45 m forward to the presenter's microphone, talks with small open-palm beats and nods (glances at the camera once), steps back

clips.layout: flipper at the origin facing -Y; the other captain at x=+1.0 facing -Y; presenter at (0.5, -1.6) facing +Y; coin positions in the flipper's frame (subtract 1.0 from x for the other captain's)
clips.note: the calling captain (1.0 m to the flipper's left): calls with a raised finger while the coin is up, follows it down, leans in to see it

clips.layout: flipper at the origin facing -Y; the other captain at x=+1.0 facing -Y; presenter at (0.5, -1.6) facing +Y; coin positions in the flipper's frame (subtract 1.0 from x for the other captain's)
clips.note: holds the coin on the thumb, cocks it, flicks it up; watches it rise and fall, a short glance at it on the ground, then eyes up (level) to the presenter

clips.layout: flipper at the origin facing -Y; the other captain at x=+1.0 facing -Y; presenter at (0.5, -1.6) facing +Y; coin positions in the flipper's frame (subtract 1.0 from x for the other captain's)
clips.note: the other captain, hands clasped in front: watches the flip, follows the coin up and down, a short glance at it on the ground, then eyes up (level) to the presenter
turns to the presenter and mimes a short drive with both hands: 'we will have a bat'
turns to the presenter, points out to the field with a sweep of the arm, rolls the bowling arm over once: 'we will bowl'
walks out 7 m to the centre and stops, facing the way he walked (-Y); place his start 7 m short of the toss spot
turns round, walks ~6 m back to his position, turns to face the batter and crouches into the ready stance
walking out clapping (6 claps per loop, hands meeting in front of the chest)
the fielding side walking out together: relaxed walk, arms swinging, a glance to the team-mate either side
big straight-arm circles, two forward and two back, then two cross-body shoulder swings
heel forward with the toe up, hinges at the hips with a flat back, hands slide down to the shin; right then left
high knees on the spot, thighs to horizontal at about 3.3 steps/s, arms driving; back to standing
jogs about 3 m, gathers, springs into a tuck jump (hips +0.45 m), lands soft and stands
stands on one leg, pulls the heel to the backside with the same hand, free arm out for balance; right then left
wide stance, sinks into a side lunge to the right, back through the centre, to the left; twice
a 10 m burst from standing, decelerates over three steps, stops and stands

clips.prop: ball on the bowling hand (in the other hand around frame 85)
clips.note: shines the ball on the front of his thigh, checks the shine, looks down at the batter, flips it into the other hand and back
from his crease turns round and paces out 8 long strides looking at his feet, scrapes the mark twice with his boot, turns to face the batter
holds the microphone out toward the captain in front of him to his right and listens, small nods
talks into the hand-held microphone to camera (-Y), open-palm beats with the free hand, turns to each captain behind him

clips.note: bat tucked under the right forearm; lifts the helmet with the top hand, pulls it down over the head, fastens the chin strap, sets the peak, a little shake of the head to settle it; ends in the walk-out stand
